body:
Triage (first-touch): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:devx`; rationale: latent but load-bearing — the failure direction is invisible (green-over-zero indistinguishable from green-over-real), the repo refuses this exact shape elsewhere by name (#4690, `trackedFiles`), and both halves are S-size mechanical with named sibling models (`check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs`). Scope: both halves — module-derived root for `EXAMPLES_DIR`/`BASELINE_PATH`, and refuse the empty population instead of returning `[]`. Type Task. Size/model suggestion: S, `mode:subagent`, model: sonnet.
